summary: Startup Wise Guys now lists the 21st Founders Club cohort with applications through November 2, but does not state the year. It is a three-month online B2B founder program with participant fees and conditional investment opportunities.

sources.title: The Founders Club
sources.supports: 21st cohort, yearless November 2 cutoff, three-month online format and fee schedule.

notes: Exact ISO deadline left unset because the year is not explicit. Fees: €1,000+VAT individuals, €1,500+VAT teams, €500+VAT CTO/developers. Investment up to €100K is conditional and has a separate €35K program cost; not a guaranteed grant.
